gallery.more_packs: …{{count}} more packs. View all in the sprite pack manager.
gallery.host_intro: Configure only what you need: to turn your own images into shareable links, set up ①. To use someone else’s packs or image IDs, no setup is needed; ② already has a default.
gallery.auto_description: ① Automatic upload (imgbb, API key required): when you add or replace images, upload them to imgbb and bind their IDs. Keep local copies for display and use direct links in share strings so others can see the images.
gallery.auto_why: Why imgbb instead of catbox? This browser upload flow supports imgbb. The catbox API does not return the CORS headers needed for direct browser uploads, so catbox is used only to resolve image IDs below.
gallery.manual_description: ② Resolve image IDs (catbox by default, no API key): when adding images by ID or reading share strings and illustration tags, append the ID to the prefix below to make the full URL. This only resolves addresses; it does not upload images.
gallery.name: Gallery
gallery.description: Manage sprite packs: create, upload, import, export, share, and bind to characters.
gallery.key_storage_hint: The API key is stored as plain text in ST extension settings (settings.json on the ST server). It is excluded from share strings and exports. If upload fails, the local image is kept so you can retry later.

gallery.key_required: Enter an imgbb API key first (free: https://api.imgbb.com/).
